nuggets.text: The Cougars' flag has appeared on ESPN College GameDay 338 times in a row, a streak dating to 2003.
The Cougars' Ol' Crimson flag first flew at College GameDay in 2003, before a Kansas State game at Texas.
The Cougars' Ol' Crimson flag has flown at the Magic Kingdom, Times Square, Augusta National and aboard a Navy ship.
Cougars coach Kirby Moore's brother, Kellen Moore, is head coach of the NFL's New Orleans Saints.
As a Boise State receiver, Kirby Moore helped the Broncos go 45-8 with four bowl appearances.
Kirby Moore began coaching at the College of Idaho in 2014, the year the school revived its football program.
Caden Pinnick threw 32 touchdown passes at UC Davis last season and was named Big Sky Freshman of the Year.
Super Bowl LX pitted two Cougars against each other: Abraham Lucas's Seahawks beat Kyle Williams's Patriots.
Saturday is the first meeting ever between the Cougars and Kansas State; the Wildcats visit Pullman in 2029.
Every Cougars uniform carries a Colville Tribes jersey patch under the largest annual sponsorship in WSU history.
